name: Words Of My Mouth
overview: Scripture emphasizes the profound impact of our speech, urging believers to seek God's guidance in controlling their words and the meditations of their hearts, as seen in Psalms 19:14 and 141:3. The Proverbs passages reveal the power of words to either bring healing and life, like a soothing honeycomb, or stir anger and damage the spirit. Wisdom is shown in the restraint of speech, highlighting that understanding leads to careful and gracious communication, reflecting a spirit of excellence.
